entries.title: Model levels are named by how hard the task is
entries.body: The levels you place models in were High, Med and Low, the same words reasoning uses. They are now Hard, Normal and Simple, with Premium kept, and a task's card shows its Difficulty beside the model and its reasoning.

picture.alt: The Models board with its levels named Premium, Hard, Normal and Simple, and a model's panel saying it takes hard and normal tasks
